GET /A_PhysInventoryDocHeader: Reads information on physical inventory document header level
POST /A_PhysInventoryDocHeader: Creates a physical inventory document
GET /A_PhysInventoryDocHeader(FiscalYear='{FiscalYear}',PhysicalInventoryDocument='{PhysicalInventoryDocument}'): Reads information for a specific physical inventory document

GET /A_PhysInventoryDocHeader(FiscalYear='{FiscalYear}',PhysicalInventoryDocument='{PhysicalInventoryDocument}')/to_PhysicalInventoryDocumentItem: Reads information for a specific physical inventory document header and physical inventory document items
GET /A_PhysInventoryDocItem: Reads information on physical inventory items level

GET /A_PhysInventoryDocItem(FiscalYear='{FiscalYear}',PhysicalInventoryDocument='{PhysicalInventoryDocument}',PhysicalInventoryDocumentItem='{PhysicalInventoryDocumentItem}'): Reads information on physical inventory document item level for a specific physical inventory document item

PATCH /A_PhysInventoryDocItem(FiscalYear='{FiscalYear}',PhysicalInventoryDocument='{PhysicalInventoryDocument}',PhysicalInventoryDocumentItem='{PhysicalInventoryDocumentItem}'): Change a specific physical inventory document item

GET /A_PhysInventoryDocItem(FiscalYear='{FiscalYear}',PhysicalInventoryDocument='{PhysicalInventoryDocument}',PhysicalInventoryDocumentItem='{PhysicalInventoryDocumentItem}')/to_PhysicalInventoryDocument: Reads information on physical inventory document item and header level for a specific physical inventory document item

GET /A_PhysInventoryDocItem(FiscalYear='{FiscalYear}',PhysicalInventoryDocument='{PhysicalInventoryDocument}',PhysicalInventoryDocumentItem='{PhysicalInventoryDocumentItem}')/to_SerialNumbers: Reads information on serial numbers for a specific physical inventory document item
GET /A_SerialNumberPhysInventoryDoc: Reads information of serial numbers on physical inventory document items level

GET /A_SerialNumberPhysInventoryDoc(Equipment='{Equipment}',FiscalYear='{FiscalYear}',PhysicalInventoryDocument='{PhysicalInventoryDocument}',PhysicalInventoryDocumentItem='{PhysicalInventoryDocumentItem}',SerialNumberPhysicalInvtryType='{SerialNumberPhysicalInvtryType}'): Reads information of serial number on physical inventory document item level for a specific physical inventory document, item and year

PATCH /A_SerialNumberPhysInventoryDoc(Equipment='{Equipment}',FiscalYear='{FiscalYear}',PhysicalInventoryDocument='{PhysicalInventoryDocument}',PhysicalInventoryDocumentItem='{PhysicalInventoryDocumentItem}',SerialNumberPhysicalInvtryType='{SerialNumberPhysicalInvtryType}'): Set a counted serial number for a specific physical inventory document item
POST /PostDifferences: Creates the material document for the differences
POST /PostDifferencesOnItem: Creates the material document for the differences for a specific physical inventory document item
POST /InitiateRecount: Initiates a recount for the physical inventory document
POST /InitiateRecountOnItem: Initiates a recount for the specific physical inventory document
